judge.rationale: The candidate only generated the initial TDD scaffolding: a `.lore/dod.md` planning file, a partial spec (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and failing acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`). It did not implement any of the production changes in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, nor did it add `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, the new test suite will fail immediately and none of the validation behavior exists. It also completely missed updating `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts`, `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
